elements.name: bind
elements.brief: Bind an input trigger to an action, optionally associating the binding
elements.description:
Bind an input trigger to an action, optionally associating the binding
to a specific player

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.doc: The input trigger to bind (key, gamepad, mouse etc)

parameters.name: action
parameters.doc: The action that will be generated by the trigger

parameters.name: player
parameters.doc: Optional id for a player to bind input trigger to

parameters.name: gamepad
parameters.doc: Gamepad index to bind the trigger to. **0️⃣ 0-based; passed to `in.mapper` unchanged.**

returnvalues.doc: Any previous action bound to the trigger

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.doc: The input trigger to unbind (key, gamepad, mouse etc)

parameters.name: player
parameters.doc: Optional id for a player to unbind input trigger from

parameters.name: player
parameters.doc: Optional id for a player to unbind input triggers from

elements.name: on_input
elements.brief: Handle incoming input trigger from a script by finding an binding and
elements.description:
Handle incoming input trigger from a script by finding an binding and
returning the bound action

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.doc: The input trigger received from on_input funcion (ie action_id)

parameters.name: player
parameters.doc: Optional id for a player to get input trigger binding for

parameters.name: gamepad
parameters.doc: Gamepad index the trigger came from, `action.gamepad`. **0️⃣ 0-based; passed to `in.mapper` unchanged.**

returnvalues.doc: The bound action or nil if no binding exists
